name: Search Data Structure Based Isosurface Extraction
definition: A class of methods using external search structures (indices) to speed up isosurface extraction for multiple queries by disregarding regions containing only non-active cells.
summary: Search Data Structure Based Isosurface Extraction accelerates multiple isosurface queries by using external indexes to skip non-active cells, distinguishing itself through range-based or domain-based hierarchical partitioning.
